title: ALL PLAYS
shortDescription: Team schedules, rosters, messages, game-day tools, stats, and family updates.
fullDescription:
ALL PLAYS keeps youth sports teams, coaches, and families connected in one organized place.

Plan the season
• Share team and player schedules
• Track RSVPs and availability
• Keep rosters and player information organized
• Coordinate assignments, rides, and team activity

Stay connected
• Send team messages and announcements
• Give parents a clear view of upcoming events and action items
• Keep coaches, staff, and families working from the same information

Be ready for game day
• Build lineups and game plans
• Track scores, stats, playing time, and game events
• Review player development and team performance

ALL PLAYS supports multiple sports and role-based experiences for parents, coaches, team administrators, and scorekeepers. Athlete and team information is private by default and shared through the access controls selected by authorized adults.

Payments are not included in the initial mobile release.
